mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM x_account_gate WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM x_post WHERE target_user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM x_publish_attempt WHERE target_user_id = #{userId} AND started_at >= #{since}
SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM x_publish_attempt WHERE target_user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM x_post WHERE target_user_id = #{userId} AND generation_key = #{generationKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO x_post (post_key, target_user_id, generation_key, content_policy_json, body, review_note, content_version, revision, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{targetUserId}, #{generationKey}, #{contentPolicyJson}, #{body}, #{reviewNote}, #{contentVersion}, #{revision}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM x_post ORDER BY created_at DESC, post_key LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO x_post_history (post_key, revision, content_version, status, body, reviewer, review_reason, attempt_id, external_post_id, last_error, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{revision}, #{contentVersion}, #{status}, #{body}, #{reviewer}, #{reviewReason}, #{attemptId}, #{postId}, #{lastError}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM x_post_history WHERE post_key = #{id} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO x_publish_attempt (attempt_id, post_id, target_user_id, content_version, status, started_at) VALUES (#{attemptId}, #{id}, #{targetUserId}, #{contentVersion}, #{status}, #{publishStartedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE x_publish_attempt SET status = #{status}, external_post_id = #{postId}, last_error = #{lastError}, completed_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'
